Mumbai Crime Branch has recovered two firearms and ten live cartridges in Surat, Gujarat, in connection with the firing at actor Tiger Shroff’s car in Juhu on October 18. Four accused have been remanded to police custody till October 26. Police are conducting forensic and ballistic tests on the recovered weapons as the investigation continues. Gangster Anil Pandit, an alleged Lawrence Bishnoi gang associate, has been named a wanted accused after reportedly claiming responsibility for the attack on social media.
